offline.title: No connection
offline.text: Stories you already downloaded stay available. The rest will come back when the network does.

update.title: An update is needed
update.text: To keep listening and recording, install the latest version of Tantara.

error.title: Oops, something got stuck
error.text: It is not your fault. Try again in a moment.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.text: This page no longer exists or the link is wrong.

forbidden.title: Parents only
forbidden.text: This page is protected. Ask a parent to give you access.

server.title: Our server has a problem
server.text: It is not your fault. We are fixing it: try again in a few minutes.
